_doc: qal/vtreq -- THE THRESHOLD-VOLTAGE REQUIREMENT SWEEP. The user asked 'can QAL be faster?'; the measured answer on SG13G2 is NO and it reduces to one device number, |Vtp| = 0.4403 V MEASURED against a ~0.75-0.77 V hop-delivered rail. This run converts that into a REQUIREMENT: what threshold would QAL need, and what does buying it cost. PSP103 exposes DELVTO as an INSTANCE parameter (PSP103_module.include:142, IPRnb DELVTO, default 0.0; PSP103_macrodefs.include:356 VFB_T = VFB_i + STVFB_i*delT + DELVTO_i), so threshold is directly sweepable without inventing a device model. Written BEFORE any result deck in this directory exists. This file is the ONLY file in qal/vtreq at the moment it is written.
own_cache: PYMS_VAE_CACHE=<scratchpad>/vae_cache_vtreq -- MY OWN, built from scratch, nothing copied in (copying a vae cache is the shell-cache poisoning trap the record already root-caused, stat-sim 59bc4aa).
reads_not_writes: qal/lsweep, qal/dvopt (incl. load691, skept2), qal/restore5, qal/chain3, qal/skip4, qal/skiptu, qal/ptu are READ ONLY from here. Nothing in this run writes into any of them. qal/ptu is a SIBLING STUDY in flight as this file is written (its PRE_REGISTERED.json 01:30:52, instr_anchor.log 01:41:22); I do not touch it and I take no number from it.

WHAT_THIS_IS_NOT.not_a_body_bias_study: The user PARKED body bias until real PDKs are in hand ('leave body-bias until we have real PDKs'). This run does NOT un-park it. DELVTO here is a DEVICE-PARAMETER SENSITIVITY SWEEP answering 'what would be needed', not a claim that any particular technology delivers it.
WHAT_THIS_IS_NOT.not_an_FDX_claim: There is no FDX/22FDX PDK on this machine. Any sentence about whether an FD-SOI back-gate can deliver the required shift is ASSUMED/REFERENCE and will be labelled as such, or omitted.
WHAT_THIS_IS_NOT.not_a_reopening: The committed energy EXCLUSION verdict (complete timer ledger 23.213 fJ/bank/hop against a pre-stated <= 12.7467 fJ, stat-sim c814e52) is NOT reopened and NOT affected by anything here. This run is about THRESHOLD and SPEED/SEPARATION/LEAKAGE, not about the switch timing hardware.

THE_TRAP_THIS_RUN_EXISTS_TO_AVOID.statement: LOWERING Vt MAKES CMOS FASTER TOO. A study that shifts QAL's devices and compares against an unshifted CMOS reference measures nothing.
THE_TRAP_THIS_RUN_EXISTS_TO_AVOID.rule: The SAME DELVTO, in the SAME mode, is applied to the CMOS comparator at EVERY point. Every Q1 row reports a RATIO of two numbers taken under the identical device shift. No QAL number is ever quoted against a DELVTO=0 CMOS number.
THE_TRAP_THIS_RUN_EXISTS_TO_AVOID.the_committed_CMOS_anchor_cannot_be_shif: The campaign's standing CMOS logic level is 92.8 ps = sha_slice generic, 0.928 ns over depth 10, taken from SYNTHESIS/STA against the SG13G2 1.20 V liberty (qal/dvopt/RESULTS.json line 5-6). An STA number cannot be DELVTO-swept without re-characterising a liberty, which this run does not do. Therefore Q1 is reported in TWO layers, both pre-stated here: (L1) a DEVICE-LEVEL, ISO-CELL, ISO-LOAD CMOS comparator that CAN be swept, defined in Q1_METHOD below, giving the ratio directly; and (L2) a RELATIVE GAIN g(delvto) = [t_QAL(delvto)/t_QAL(0)] / [t_CMOS_dev(delvto)/t_CMOS_dev(0)] which is applied to the committed 1.244-1.305x band to produce the spec answer. g is dimensionless and does not inherit the absolute-level disagreement between the two comparators. If the L1 ratio at DELVTO=0 differs materially from 1.244-1.305, I will say so plainly and state why rather than quietly adopting whichever anchor flatters QAL.

committed_robust_single_hop.source: qal/restore5/RESULTS.json instrument_check.committed_single_hop (itself a digit-identical re-run of the committed deck)

MEASURED_ANCHORS_I_AM_STARTING_FROM_all_.committed_ratio_band: 115.47 - 121.15 ps = 1.244x - 1.305x the 92.8 ps CMOS logic level

separation_by_bank_depth.note: MEASURED from qal/restore5/rows.json k6_T300_control outputs_at_own_boundary_V, banks 1..6; the published series is the MAGNITUDE. Banks 2 and 4 are NEGATIVE, i.e. the stage's HIGH group sits BELOW its LOW group: that stage carries no correct information at all, not merely a degraded level. I record this now so it is not presented later as a discovery.
separation_by_bank_depth.deck: qal/restore5/s_k6_T300.cir, k=6 NO-RESTORE control, 6 banks, L=15 nH, W=30 um, dV=1.2, T=300 ps

sigma_Vt.source: IHP sg13g2_moslv_mismatch.lib delvto_mm = 0.0039 as recorded in qal_atrack_status; carried by the campaign as the PDK noise floor
sigma_Vt.ASSUMPTION_DECLARED_NOW: I ASSUME sigma_Vt is INDEPENDENT of DELVTO, i.e. shifting the mean threshold does not change its standard deviation. This is the standard first-order reading of a DELVTO-style mismatch card (delvto_mm is an absolute-volts sigma on the same additive parameter I am sweeping, not a fraction of Vt). It is an ASSUMPTION and the conclusion's sensitivity to it is reported explicitly: for every depth I will also report the sigma_Vt value that WOULD move the verdict, so a reader with a different mismatch model can re-decide without re-running.

held_rail_droop_DELVTO_0.at: T = 105 ps, worst of the qal/skip4 hold rows; -20.2 mV (-3.30%) over the 1.12-beat passive hold at T = 120

o21ai.cell: sg13g2_o21ai_1 topology, Y = !((A1|A2)&B1), the Vortex ALU's dominant mapped cell
o21ai.committed_state: at dV=1.65 it settles inside a 500 ps window (t_valid90 = 495.5 ps at L=15/W=30, 406.2 ps at L=6/W=120) = 4.4x-5.5x the 92.8 ps CMOS level, against 0.80x for the shallow-stack bank at the same swing (qal/dvopt/RESULTS.json). Earlier campaign text says 'never settles anywhere in the PDK envelope'; dvopt superseded that as a DELIVERY+WINDOW failure rather than a headroom failure. I take the dvopt numbers as the DELVTO=0 anchor and say so.

METHOD.delvto_plumbing: A LOCAL shim, qal/vtreq/shim_dvt.sp, identical to the committed qal/sg13lv_compat.sp except that sg13_lv_nmos passes DELVTO={DVTN} and sg13_lv_pmos passes DELVTO={DVTP} to its M card, where DVTN/DVTP are GLOBAL .param values the deck sets. PYMS_CALLBACK_PARAMS=DELVTO keeps DELVTO symbolic in the vae .so so one .so per geometry serves every DELVTO value (xyce_device_gen.py lines 793-820: callback params are serialized into the cache key as 0.0). The committed shim is NOT modified.
METHOD.why_a_local_shim_is_safe: It is a strict superset: at DVTN = DVTP = 0 the deck must reproduce the committed numbers. That is gate G0 and it is a hard gate.
METHOD.sign_convention_MEASURED_not_assumed: PSP103 adds DELVTO to the flatband voltage in the device's own internal (type-flipped) frame, so the sign that LOWERS |Vt| may differ between nMOS and pMOS. Gate G1 MEASURES d|Vt|/d(DELVTO) for each type and the sweep is then expressed in terms of the REDUCTION in |Vt| actually achieved, not in terms of the raw parameter. Every table column is labelled with the measured |Vt| it corresponds to, not only with the DELVTO that produced it.

grid.why_three_modes: the campaign MEASURED the limiting device to SWITCH between regimes: single hops and free-running chains bind on the pMOS pull-UP, topped-up chains bind on the nMOS pull-DOWN. A both-device shift cannot attribute; the split modes can.
grid.operating_points: dV = 1.65 V where characterised (the measured optimum of qal/dvopt), dV = 1.2 V as the cross-check. L per the committed optimum for that load/point; true current zero RE-PROBED per DELVTO and per L, never inherited.

Q1_METHOD.QAL_side: qal/skept/sk.py + qal/dvopt/skept2/s2sk.py path, IMPORTED not copied (this is the independently-written generator + waveform-only extractor that reproduced the committed rows bit-identically), rebound to this directory and MY cache, with the DELVTO shim substituted for the committed shim. Point: L = 4 nH, W = 30 um, dV = 1.65, CL = 6.91 fF, 8 metered inverter cells. The reported level time is t_valid90 = all 8 cells simultaneously within 10% of the INSTANTANEOUS rail and staying there, measured from switch close -- the SAME convention that produced 115.467185 ps.
Q1_METHOD.CMOS_side_defined_precisely_so_it_cannot: CMOS_dev = the SAME campaign inverter (pMOS w = 1.12 um, nMOS w = 0.74 um, l = 0.13 um) on a FIXED DC rail at 1.20 V, driving the SAME 6.91 fF load, input driven by an ideal 2 ps edge, output level time = time to 90% of its own rail, worst of RISE (pMOS-limited) and FALL (nMOS-limited). This is the committed floor-curve 'zc' form (qal/dvopt/floor_inv_c*.cir), whose 2 fF value 57.14 ps is already a per-deck instrument check in the committed record. ISO-CELL and ISO-LOAD against the QAL bank, and both sides get an ideal input, so neither is advantaged on drive. A VDD = 1.50 V variant is reported alongside because the PDK ships the identical 84-cell library at 1.50 V.

acceptance.PARITY: t_QAL(delvto) / t_CMOS_dev(delvto) <= 1.00, both measured under the identical shift
acceptance.and_on_the_committed_anchor: relative gain g(delvto) <= 1/1.305 = 0.766 for parity against the worst committed ratio, <= 1/1.244 = 0.804 against the best

Q1_METHOD.what_would_make_this_row_VOID: a QAL row whose 8 cells do not all settle, or whose |IZ| at switch open exceeds 1.0 uA, is VOID and is reported as VOID rather than as a fast level.

Q2_METHOD.vehicle: qal/restore5 rest.py k = 6 NO-RESTORE control, 6 hop-powered banks, L = 15 nH, W = 30 um, dV = 1.2, T = 300 ps -- the deck that produced the committed 528.68/22.89/1.52/0.122/0.010/0.001 mV series. Harness imported, shim substituted, own cache, true zero re-probed per DELVTO.
Q2_METHOD.metric: separation_k = min over the pull-UP cells of V(o_k,i) MINUS max over the pull-DOWN cells of V(o_k,i), at bank k's own stage boundary, in mV, SIGNED. Per bank, never aggregated across banks.
Q2_METHOD.floor: 3.42 mV (sigma_Vt, ASSUMED DELVTO-independent, see above). A stage PASSES at depth k if separation_k is POSITIVE and exceeds 3.42 mV.
Q2_METHOD.depths_asked_for: 3, 5, 10. The committed control is 6 banks deep. Depths 3 and 5 are MEASURED. Depth 6 is MEASURED. DEPTH 10 IS NOT SIMULATED and any depth-10 statement is an EXTRAPOLATION from the measured per-hop attenuation ratio and will be labelled DERIVED, with the ratio it rests on printed.
Q2_METHOD.the_mechanism_test_that_is_cheap_and_run: The chain result is a consequence of a DC inequality the campaign already isolated: the predecessor's forward-transferred HIGH strands at ~|Vtp| (MEASURED 0.336-0.455 V over 23 chain3 rows) while the successor needs ~0.59 x rail. Both sides are DC quantities. I will therefore ALSO measure, at EVERY point of the 16-point grid, (i) |Vtp| by the campaign's own criterion and (ii) the receiving cell's DC trip point at the delivered rail, and report the SIGNED GAP. This is the mechanism; the chain decks are the confirmation.

Q3_METHOD.leakage: DC: Id at Vgs = 0 for the cell nMOS (0.74 um) and cell pMOS (1.12 um) at |Vds| = the delivered rail, per DELVTO per mode; and the whole 8-cell bank's static current drawn from a held rail. Reported in A and converted to charge lost per beat at T = 120 and T = 300 ps.
Q3_METHOD.held_rail_droop: TRANSIENT: reservoir CA = 35.979 fF (the committed single hop's own source) plus one 8-cell inverter bank, rail initialised to the delivered level, ALL switches open, no hop -- i.e. the passive hold qal/skip4 measured at -20.2 mV over 1.12 beats. Droop read at 105, 120, 200 and 300 ps, per DELVTO per mode.
Q3_METHOD.the_crossover_this_answers: the DELVTO at which the held-rail droop over ONE beat exceeds the settling margin that the same DELVTO bought. Stated as a signed budget in mV, not as a rhetorical claim.

METHOD.Q_o21ai_METHOD: sk.py kind='o21ai' (8 cells, the demanding A1 = A2 = 0 case whose output must follow the rail up through the 2-HIGH series pMOS stack; l = 0.13 um where the mapped netlist uses 0.15 um, so GENEROUS to QAL) at dV = 1.65, L = 15 nH, W = 30 um, at DELVTO = 0 and at the MOST FAVOURABLE point the Q1 grid identifies. Question: does a lower threshold move the 2-high stack from 4.4x-5.5x the CMOS level into the shallow-stack class, i.e. does it change the LIBRARY RESTRICTION.

ACCEPTANCE_GATES_in_order.G0_instrument_HARD: Under this directory's own cache, with the DELVTO shim at DVTN = DVTP = 0: (a) the committed robust single hop reproduces VBEND = 0.7138163, VBPK = 0.8368896, t_hop = 65.49500982344826 at rel < 1e-6 on all three; (b) the committed real-load level reproduces t_valid90 = 115.467185 ps at rel < 1e-4 (looser than (a) because it is a waveform-scan quantity on a printed grid, not a .measure). IF EITHER FAILS, NOTHING IN THIS RUN REPORTS.
ACCEPTANCE_GATES_in_order.G1_the_parameter_actually_reaches_the_de: For each DELVTO value and each mode, the MEASURED shift in |Vt| (campaign criterion, Id = 100 nA*W/L at |Vds| = 0.1 V) must be at least 0.5x the applied |DELVTO| on the device(s) the mode targets, AND under 0.1x on the device(s) it does not target, AND the inverter DC trip point must move monotonically. If the measured |d|Vt|/d(DELVTO)| is below 0.5 on a targeted device, the sweep is declared NON-FUNCTIONAL and nothing downstream reports. Rationale: a sweep whose parameter is silently ignored is this campaign's oldest failure mode.
ACCEPTANCE_GATES_in_order.G2_ZCS_hygiene: true current zero RE-PROBED per DELVTO, per mode and per L; |IZ| at switch open < 1.0 uA on every reported hop row; a row failing it is reported as instrument-unclean and excluded from the verdict, with the exclusion stated.
ACCEPTANCE_GATES_in_order.G3_metering: 1F-integrator or INTEG-I(Vsrc)+PARAM only; every 1F integrator t0-referenced at 0.5 ps to remove its pedestal.
ACCEPTANCE_GATES_in_order.G4_per_gate_never_aggregated: settling and separation are reported per gate / per bank. A bank that passes on average and fails one cell has FAILED. NOTE the fixture caveat the record already established: the 8-cell bank is 2 electrically identical classes of 4, so intra-class spread is exactly zero and this convention cannot catch a single-gate outlier in THIS deck; the guard that does catch a non-computing stage here is the PATTERN GUARD (a pull-down whose gate drive is below Vtn is OFF and its node is merely undisturbed, not settled), and it is applied.
ACCEPTANCE_GATES_in_order.G5_no_forbidden_knobs: no vt/gmin adjustment; corners only via instance-level DTA; unique .va module names; every deck < 4 min except the 6-bank chain, whose committed runtime is 4.3 min and which is run as-committed.

E0_headline_prediction.statement: I expect the gap to CLOSE on Q1 (the level) somewhere in the |DELVTO| = 0.15-0.25 V range in mode B, and to NOT close on Q2 (the chain), and therefore I expect the overall answer to be that NO SINGLE THRESHOLD SATISFIES BOTH. I am stating this before the first result deck so that it cannot be dressed up afterwards.

E1_Q1_QAL_gains_more_than_CMOS.statement: The level ratio WILL improve monotonically with |DELVTO| because overdrive is (rail - |Vt|) and QAL's rail is lower. DERIVED arithmetic, from measured numbers, stated now: at the L = 4 nH real-load point VBEND = 0.754573 V so QAL pMOS overdrive is 0.754573 - 0.440273 = 0.314300 V; CMOS at 1.20 V has 0.759727 V. A 0.20 V reduction gives 0.514300 (x1.6363) and 0.959727 (x1.2633). If level time scales as overdrive^-alpha, the relative gain is g = (1.2633/1.6363)^alpha = 0.7720^alpha: g = 0.772 at alpha = 1.0, 0.715 at alpha = 1.3, 0.679 at alpha = 1.5. Parity against the committed band needs g <= 0.766-0.804. So DERIVED, parity is MARGINAL at 0.20 V and depends on alpha, which is why it is measured.
E1_Q1_QAL_gains_more_than_CMOS.confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH for the direction, LOW for the exact crossing
E1_Q1_QAL_gains_more_than_CMOS.falsifier: the ratio failing to improve, or improving by less than 5% at |DELVTO| = 0.30 V in mode B.

E2_Q2_the_SELF_DEFEAT_and_it_is_the_inte.statement: I expect the chain to get WORSE, not better, as |Vtp| is reduced, and I expect this to be the load-bearing finding. MECHANISM, DERIVED now: the predecessor's forward-transferred HIGH strands at ~|Vtp| because once its rail has drained the output node becomes the pMOS SOURCE and conduction continues until V(out) - V(rail) < |Vtp|; so the stranded HIGH tracks |Vtp| ~1:1 and FALLS when |Vtp| falls. The successor's requirement is its own trip point, which for an inverter shifts only by delta*(1 - sqrt(r))/(1 + sqrt(r)) with r = beta_n/beta_p; for the campaign cell (1.12 um p / 0.74 um n) r ~ 1.6-1.7, sqrt(r) ~ 1.28, so the trip point moves only ~0.12x as far as the threshold does, and in the same direction. NET DERIVED: a 0.20 V reduction in |Vtp| costs ~0.200 V of stranded HIGH and returns only ~0.025 V of relaxed requirement -- it OPENS the 34.7 mV shortfall by roughly 0.175 V instead of closing it. If that is what the measurement shows, then the Q1 cure and the Q2 cure pull in OPPOSITE directions and the answer is a device spec that cannot be satisfied at one threshold.
E2_Q2_the_SELF_DEFEAT_and_it_is_the_inte.confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH on the mechanism, MEDIUM on the magnitude
E2_Q2_the_SELF_DEFEAT_and_it_is_the_inte.falsifier: separation at bank 3 rising above +3.42 mV at any negative-|Vt| point in any mode, or the stranded HIGH failing to track |Vtp| within +/-25%. Either would be a genuinely new result and I would say so loudly.

E3_Q3_leakage.statement: Subthreshold Id(Vgs=0) will rise roughly exponentially, ~1 decade per 80-100 mV of threshold reduction (the campaign's own softplus fit gave NSS = 1.85, i.e. ~110 mV/decade at 300 K; qal/va). So |DELVTO| = 0.30 V is DERIVED to cost 10^2.7 - 10^3.8 in off-current. Held-rail droop should scale with it, from the measured -20.2 to -28.6 mV baseline. I expect the held-rail droop to exceed 100 mV per beat somewhere around |DELVTO| = 0.20-0.30 V, which is where the cure costs more than the disease.
E3_Q3_leakage.confidence: HIGH on the direction, MEDIUM on where it crosses
E3_Q3_leakage.falsifier: droop not growing monotonically with |DELVTO|, or growing by less than 2x at 0.30 V.

E4_o21ai.statement: A 2-high pMOS stack loses roughly TWO threshold drops where an inverter loses one, so I expect the o21ai bank to gain MORE from a given |DELVTO| than the inverter bank does, in relative terms. This may be the most valuable row in the run: it is the one place where a threshold shift could change a LIBRARY RESTRICTION rather than a speed ratio.
E4_o21ai.falsifier: the o21ai level time improving by a SMALLER relative fraction than the inverter bank's at the same DELVTO.

PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS_with_falsifiers.E5_what_a_null_result_looks_like_and_tha: If no swept value closes the gap, 'QAL needs a threshold nobody can build' is the complete and valuable answer and it will be stated in exactly those terms, with the number that would be required.

PLAN_in_order: 1. This file (sole file on disk in qal/vtreq at write time).
2. shim_dvt.sp + geometry warm-up of MY cache (one .so per (device,W,L); DELVTO is a callback param so it does NOT multiply the builds).
3. G0 instrument check at DVTN = DVTP = 0, both anchors, digit-checked.

4. G1 DC deck: |Vt| by the campaign criterion, inverter trip point at 1.20 V and at the delivered rail, Id at fixed Vgs, Id at Vgs = 0, for the full 16-point grid. This is the gate that decides whether anything else is worth running, AND it carries the Q2 mechanism measurement and the Q3 leakage measurement.
5. Q1 QAL grid (16 points at dV = 1.65 / L = 4 nH / CL = 6.91 fF) + the CMOS_dev comparator at the same 16 points + the dV = 1.2 cross-check subset.
6. Q3 held-rail droop transient, full grid.
7. Q2 chain: restore5 k=6 control at a subset of the grid chosen to bracket the mechanism, with the DC mechanism measurement from step 4 covering the full grid.
8. o21ai at DELVTO = 0 and at the most favourable point.
9. THE SPEC: the |Vtp| required for parity, for a beat, and for a chain surviving depth 3 / 5 / 10 -- or the statement that no swept value gets there.

SIM_DISCIPLINE_restated.models: sg13_lv via a LOCAL copy of qal/sg13lv_compat.sp with the DELVTO hook; it ZEROES ad/as/pd/ps, so junction capacitance is absent and every device number here is a LOWER BOUND -- and note this cuts BOTH ways in this study: the missing drain junction cap is part of what would HOLD a collapsing HIGH up and part of what would SLOW a creeping LOW.
SIM_DISCIPLINE_restated.runtime: < 4 min per deck, except the committed 6-bank chain at its committed 4.3 min
SIM_DISCIPLINE_restated.metering: 1F integrators, ALWAYS t0-referenced (they carry a t = 0 pedestal)
SIM_DISCIPLINE_restated.zeros: re-probe true current zeros per L, per hop, per DELVTO and per mode
SIM_DISCIPLINE_restated.forbidden: vt/gmin adjustments; corners only via instance-level DTA
SIM_DISCIPLINE_restated.scope: ALL numbers are SHALLOW-STACK unless the row says o21ai

HONESTY_CLAUSES.labels: every number labelled MEASURED / DERIVED / ASSUMED.
HONESTY_CLAUSES.twenty_plus_corrections: this campaign has taken 20+ corrections including a verdict that rested on a substituted mechanism. No verdict here rests on a quantity I did not measure in this directory, except the committed anchors, which are re-run and digit-checked, and the 92.8 ps STA level, which is explicitly declared unshiftable and handled by the two-layer scheme above.
HONESTY_CLAUSES.no_post_hoc_metric: Q1/Q2/Q3 acceptance and the o21ai question are fixed above. Anything I find that is worth having but was not pre-stated is reported as EXPLORATORY and kept out of the verdict.
HONESTY_CLAUSES.confirmation_is_a_result: if DELVTO changes nothing, that is a clean confirmation and is reported as one, with the sensitivity quantified rather than asserted.
HONESTY_CLAUSES.the_spec_framing: the answer is delivered as a DEVICE SPEC -- 'QAL needs |Vtp| <= X V at a Y V delivered rail to reach Z' -- not as an FD-SOI claim.
